headline: The incredible flying Tesla Roadster is just for show
summary: Elon Musk showcased a Tesla Roadster stunt involving vertical driving and mid-air maneuvers. The car executed a 'kickflip' and landed using cold-gas thrusters. This 'flying car' demonstration is purely for show and not a production reality.

headline: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
summary: Meta's upcoming terms, effective October 30th, grant it permission to crawl business-associated websites. This includes scraping content from online publishers. Meta plans to use this external content to 'develop, improve, research,' and 'train' its AI.

headline: This stretchy MagSafe storage pouch gives your phone a sizable trunk
summary: A new MagSafe Flex Pouch offers external storage for smartphones. It attaches magnetically and is compatible with wireless chargers. The stretchy pouch provides physical storage, not digital memory for apps or photos.

headline: iPhone Duo orders are already delayed into 2027
summary: Preorder delivery estimates for the iPhone Duo quickly extended into 2027. Within an hour of opening, all configurations showed late January 2027 delivery dates. The foldable iPhone is still slated for an October 23rd in-store launch.

headline: Street Fighter’s 4K Steelbook Is Up for Preorder, and Comes in Champion or Villain Variants
summary: Street Fighter's 4K Steelbook Edition is now available for preorder on Amazon. Fans can choose between special champion or villain variant cover art. This collector's item targets dedicated Street Fighter enthusiasts.

headline: The 'Father of PlayStation' Says Killing Discs Backlash Is a 'Mentality Issue'
summary: Ken Kutaragi, the 'Father of PlayStation,' supports Sony's decision to drop physical discs for the PS5. He understands the backlash but deems physical media 'not economically reasonable.' Kutaragi led Sony's gaming division through the first three PlayStation generations.

headline: This Fallout Power Fist 1:1 Scale Replica Will Have You Ready for Any Post-Apocalyptic Future
summary: An officially licensed 1:1 scale replica of the Fallout Power Fist has been revealed. It offers a perfect addition for fans of the iconic post-apocalyptic game series. The replica was showcased exclusively during IGN Fan Fest: Fall Edition 2026.

headline: Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 Review
summary: This article presents a review of the Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20. The review provides insights and opinions on the device's performance. Further details about the device can be found within the full review.

headline: Zelensky says Ukraine has right to defend itself after Trump calls refinery strikes a 'disgrace'
summary: Zelensky asserted Ukraine's right to self-defense after Trump criticized refinery strikes. Trump called Ukraine's attacks on Russian refineries a 'disgrace.' EU leaders have rallied to support Ukraine's president.

headline: Norwegian teen 'hitman' detained for UK murder plot
summary: A 19-year-old Norwegian, Johannes Natland, was detained for a UK murder plot. He traveled to West Yorkshire last March to carry out a 'hit.' The teen is implicated in a planned murder.

headline: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians in West Bank during olive harvest
summary: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian farmers in the West Bank. The attacks occurred during the olive harvest season. Settlers were also seen setting fire to olive trees.

headline: British father fined for causing his two-year-old son's death in Cyprus hotel fall
summary: A British father was fined for his role in his two-year-old son's death. The child fell from a Cyprus hotel window. The father, Joshua Foster, reportedly 'lost control' while showing his son the view.
